description: Ayyukan tokenised deposits na 2026 suna tafiya daga bincike zuwa gwaji na banki da shawarwari na farko ga abokan ciniki. Matsayin yana pre-scale har yanzu, amma alkibla tana bayyane: ana daidaita kuɗin banki na kasuwanci don programmable settlement, digital wallets, stablecoin interoperability, da tokenised capital markets.
